title: Writing pages
text:
Code
A code block can show a file name.


hello.py

def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}"

A code block can number its lines.


python

first = 1
second = 2
total = first + second

A terminal block shows a command and its output. A line that starts with $ and a space is a command.


Terminal

echo "Hello"
Hello

title: Configuration
text: This guide shows how to change the site. Two files control how the site looks.

title: Configuration
text:
The site file
The file _quarto.yml holds the title, the navigation, and the options of the site. Change the title and the description first.


_quarto.yml

website:
  title: "My project"
  description: "A short description of my project."

Change repo-url to the address of your repository.

title: Configuration
text:
The brand file
The file _brand.yml holds the colours of the site. Each colour has a light value and a dark value. The site uses the primary colour for the current item and for links.


_brand.yml

color:
  primary:
    light: "#1d5fd1"
    dark: "#7fa8f0"







TipTest both colour schemes



Change the colour scheme of your system. Make sure that the text is easy to read in both schemes.
